invariants.statement: No published snapshot without successful import batch.
No batch approval without required validations.
At most one ACTIVE snapshot exists per tenant and dataset type.
Every financial fact references its source snapshot.
Every snapshot references its import batch.
Every batch traces to immutable file SHA-256 and import profile version.
No sensitive financial query without active membership.
No sensitive financial query without required permission.
No response when resource ownership does not match authorized supplier.
Enrollment denial approval company change and sensitive query are audited.
Unknown SAP status is never inferred.
Snapshot data is never represented as real-time SAP data.
Failed publication never partially replaces active snapshot.
RUC alone never creates an ACTIVE membership.
A user-supplied new contact destination is not automatically trusted.
Duplicate file and import side effects are idempotent.
